patterns.note: Full-viewport height sections that replace each other on scroll, creating a distinct narrative flow rather than continuous scrolling.
Juxtaposition of oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings with smaller, clean sans-serif for supporting text and labels, creating strong visual hierarchy.
Dominant black background with stark white text, accented by vibrant primary colors (blue, red, yellow) used in pixel art illustrations and generative background animations.
Scroll-triggered full-page section transitions, where each new section slides into view to replace the previous one, creating a sequential narrative experience.
Dynamic, generative background animations using canvas, featuring abstract shapes and subtle color shifts that provide a living backdrop to the main hero text.
Consistent use of pixel art illustrations and iconography throughout the site, from the initial hero character to small decorative elements and skill icons, reinforcing a retro-digital aesthetic.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-page scroll-snapping or section-based scrolling system, where each major content block occupies the entire viewport and transitions smoothly into place as the user scrolls, likely using a JavaScript library or custom scroll-snap implementation.

Dynamic background visuals are created using canvas animation, generating abstract, fluid patterns that subtly shift color and form behind the main textual content, enhancing the digital and creative feel.
Pixel art assets are integrated throughout the design, from hero illustrations to small decorative icons, providing a consistent retro-digital aesthetic that contrasts with the modern typography.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~4-5x body) paired with clean, legible sans-serif for supporting text and labels.

design_tokens.spacing: Airy, full-bleed sections with generous vertical spacing between major content blocks, but dense within the '5 Years in Design' skill list.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the seamless integration of pixel art aesthetics with modern, bold typography and dynamic generative art backgrounds. This creates a unique retro-futuristic and playful yet professional brand identity that stands out from typical design portfolios.
